card.name: Punctuation after drug name in dosing section
card.fires_on: The opening parenthesis, comma, or 'for' right after a drug's product name at the start of a dosage and administration section. It fires where the name is followed by its generic name, dosage form, or a first instruction.

modes.label: Open parenthesis after name
modes.description: A '(' directly after a brand or drug name, introducing the generic name or form.

modes.label: Comma or 'for' after name
modes.description: A comma or the word 'for' after a drug name and before its form or a statement.
modes.example: DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION CIDOFOVIR INJECTION<<,>> USP MUST NOT BE ADMINISTERED
